description:
Where one title plays from in a member's browser, at the stack's front door, on a
pass sealing a session on their own account.

id.description: The title or episode, by the identifier the shelf lists it under.

lapses.description:
When the pass lapses, in whole seconds since the Unix epoch. A browser hands it
back for a new one before then.

member.description: The member it plays as, by the name they are known by.

rehearsed.description: Whether this was a rehearsal: what would have happened, with none of it done.

stream_from.description: The playlist it plays from at the front door, carrying its pass.

unlocated.description: Why nothing is located, where nothing is.
